description: Finite-control-set model-predictive dq current control: at every control period the node evaluates all 8 two-level inverter switching vectors against a one-step Euler prediction of the PMSM dq current model (Ld, Lq, Rs, Lambda) and applies the minimum-cost vector directly as leg duties (100/0 percent, no SVPWM stage). PI loops and the modulator stay unused. Cost = (IdRef-id)^2 + (IqRef-iq)^2 + SwitchPenalty*(legs changed). A continuous-set MPC is out of scope on purpose: the graph/node model has no interior QP solver foot-print and no way to express a continuous voltage output through the duty percent seam without a modulator, which would silently reintroduce exactly the averaged modulator the method is defined against; the finite set is what the platform's duty interface expresses natively.

inputPorts.name: Theta
inputPorts.description: Electrical rotor angle used to rotate the switching vectors into the dq frame, rad.

inputPorts.name: RpmElec
inputPorts.description: Electrical rotor speed, RPM (hw.rpm convention; converted to rad/s internally).

outputPorts.name: Duty_A
outputPorts.description: Phase A leg duty, percent: 100 or 0 (direct switching, 50 = zero-vector convention upstream does not apply here).

outputPorts.name: V_D
outputPorts.description: d-axis voltage of the selected vector this period, V (diagnostics).

outputPorts.name: V_Q
outputPorts.description: q-axis voltage of the selected vector this period, V (diagnostics).

outputPorts.name: SwitchCode
outputPorts.description: Selected switch state as 3-bit code (Sa*4 + Sb*2 + Sc), 0-7.

Dt.description: Prediction horizon = control period, seconds (the period this node executes at; e.g. 400 us at tim_isr 2.5 kHz).

Rs.description: Stator winding resistance per phase, ohm.

SwitchPenalty.description: Cost added per leg state change vs the previously applied vector (A^2 units on the J scale); 0 disables switching-cost weighting.

PrevSa.description: Persistent state: previously applied phase A switch state (0/1).

PrevSb.description: Persistent state: previously applied phase B switch state (0/1).

PrevSc.description: Persistent state: previously applied phase C switch state (0/1).
